steps.text: Split into two teams; each picks a spymaster; spymasters sit on the same side
20 random pictures in a 5 x 4 grid (marked corner top-left)
Random key card on the stand between the spymasters, matching the grid
7 red and 7 blue agent cards by their spymasters; the double agent flipped to the starting team's color
4 innocent bystanders and the assassin card within reach
The key card's lights show the starting team (8 pictures to find); its spymaster gives the first clue
